Accuracy and fairness

Corrections & Complaints

We want IMMA News to be accurate and fair. If you think we got something wrong, please tell us.

Last updated: 25 November 2026

Report an error

If a story, guide or other page on IMMA News contains a factual error, a misleading headline or an outdated detail, let us know. It helps us if you include:

  • the headline or a link to the page;
  • what you believe is wrong, and what is correct;
  • any evidence or official source that shows it (for example a link to a government notice);
  • how we can reach you if we have a question (optional).

Report an error Report it on WhatsApp

You can also call us on +254 785 887 830.

What happens next

  • An editor checks your report against the original sources.
  • If we find an error, we correct the page promptly. Where a correction changes the meaning of a story, we say so on the story.
  • If we decide the page is accurate, we will tell you why if you left contact details.

For the information in Kenya at Your Fingertips, the official office or website is always the final authority. Each guide shows when we last checked it and links to its official source.

Other complaints

About our journalism or conduct

Tell us using the contact form (choose Corrections or complaints). Please give as much detail as you can. Our editorial principles are set out in our Editorial Standards.

About an advert or sponsored content

Adverts and sponsored articles must follow our Advertising Terms. To report one, use the contact form and tell us where you saw it.

About your personal data

See our Privacy Policy for your rights and how to use them. You can also complain to the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner at odpc.go.ke.

If you are not satisfied

If you are unhappy with how we handled your complaint about our journalism, you can contact the Media Council of Kenya, which handles complaints against media in Kenya, at mediacouncil.or.ke.
